      "note_section": "plan",
      "note_span": "Discharge with GP follow-up if first troponin normal.",

        44

      "severity": 5,
      "likelihood": 5,
      "rationale": "The note specifies discharge, while the transcript indicates admission to the cardiology team, which is a critical difference in patient management."
    }
  ],
  "overall_note_safety": "needs_major_edits"
